text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
InRange(x, y) ::: x is in the range y.
HasMine(x) ::: x has a mine.

Premises:
PicurisMountains(x) ∧ MountainRange(x) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range.
LocatedIn(juanDeOnate, x) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(hardingPegmatiteMine) ∧ LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, x) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is located in the Picuris Mountains.
Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine was donated.
∀x (MountainRange(x) ∧ LocatedIn(y, x) ∧ HasMine(y) → ¬(x = texas)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.

Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, texas) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine is not located in a mountain range in Texas.
